title: secp256k1-ecdlp: compact-record radix-bucket BSGS truncated at 39/100

claims.statement: For uniform x in [0,r), input Q=[x]P for the fixed standard secp256k1 generator P, the deterministic compact-record radix-bucket baby-step/giant-step procedure in proof.md recovers x on every scalar in the initial segment [0, m^2) and therefore succeeds with probability at least 39/100. It uses at most 2^128.797933 total target-group-operation equivalents under classical-group-work-v2 with C=1000, including preprocessing, the full failure path and verification. Peak memory is at most 2^135.320774 bytes. Preprocessing is at most 2^127.747307 target-group-operation equivalents and is included in the total. Nonuniform advice is 0 bytes. No hash-uniformity, random-walk or automorphism heuristic is used. The score is the rational 128797933/1000000.

experiments.purpose: Exhaustively check truncated radix-sorted BSGS recovery on a small additive cyclic group. This does not establish production field arithmetic, memory bounds, or instruction costs.
